cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested on 8 μL total of SP3 beads (Cytiva; 1:1 hydrophilic to hydrophobic beads; 50 mg/mL) in 50 μL of 50 mM HEPES (pH 8) with Trypsin/Lys-C in a 1:40 protease to protein ratio for 10 h at 37 °C/700 rpm.

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS spectra were collected with a normalized HCD collision energy of 36, 0.4 m/z isolation window, auto selected for maximum injection time mode, a normalized AGC target of 100%, at a MS2 orbitrap resolution of 45,000 with a defined first mass of 110 m/z to ensure measurement of TMTPro reporter ions.

fractionation_method.evidence: To elute peptides from the first C18 phase to the SCX resin of the MudPIT column, 10 μL of Buffer A was injected and the following 90 min gradient was utilized: 2% B (5 min hold) ramped to a mobile phase concentration of 40% B over 35 min, ramped to 80% B over 15 min, held at 80% B for 5 min, then returned to 2% B in 5 min and then held at 2% B for the remainder of the analysis at a constant flow rate 500 nL/min.
